answer: Since the inlet hash is stored at intake, the voyage graph groups the endorsements and the shale audit shows the collapse. An operator copying one text across 33 aliases as a result pays for 33 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, because the hash is the same for all of them. An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 7 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
